description: This file is the entry point for a React application using ReactDOM to render the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It initializes the React app and renders it within React's StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React application into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot().render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM.
